intent: Monitor BIDU stock price with trend and alerts on a 4x6 card
layout_desc: Stock monitoring tile: ticker identity, latest price with change as current value, price trend with alert threshold, alert conditions, and a link to the full quote page.
style_desc: Finance domain — dark tile with semantic delta colors.

sections.name: title
sections.desc: Ticker and company name with market-open status tag

sections.name: core
sections.desc: Latest price as the current value with change and change%

data_needed.name: change
data_needed.description: number, price change since previous close

data_needed.name: change_percent
data_needed.description: number, percentage change since previous close

sections.name: content
sections.desc: Recent closing-price trend with the user's alert threshold overlaid

data_needed.name: recent_prices
data_needed.description: number[], array of recent closing prices (~30 points)

sections.name: status
sections.desc: Alert condition summary and whether it has triggered

data_needed.name: triggered
data_needed.description: boolean, whether alert condition has been met

sections.name: operation
sections.desc: Entry to the full quote page

data_needed.name: detail_page_url
data_needed.description: url, link to detailed quote page
